title: Among charter schools in Santa Clara County with an SAT excellence rate abo
question: Among charter schools in Santa Clara County with an SAT excellence rate above 0.25, find the city with the lowest total K-12 enrollment and return its complete physical address (Street, City, State, Zip).

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_048, s.XCL_050, s.XCL_052, s.XCL_051
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
WHERE s.XCL_063 = 1
  AND s.XCL_045 = 'Santa Clara'
  AND CAST(sat.XCL_040 AS REAL) / sat.XCL_036 > 0.25
ORDER BY f.XCL_019 ASC
LIMIT 1
